remaining_holds: Production, governance, operational, and complete mission qualification HOLDs remain; no work package marked complete.

requirement.title: Temporal authority
requirement.acceptance: Expiry is exclusive; full clock uncertainty interval must fit grant interval. Revoke and dispatch admission serialize within their authority domain. No admission after committed revoke; stale worker leases cannot commit. Unknown clock trust or rollback yields HOLD.
requirement.verification_method: Exact-expiry, skew, rollback and revoke-race boundary tests

failure_disposition.operation: Preserve native DENIED/HOLD/OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN as applicable; no effect or promotion beyond proved state
failure_disposition.qualification: HOLD affected package; retain failure and open RRCA/change record

requirement.falsifier: Any execution contradicting this acceptance statement, or any required evidence missing/invalid, prevents satisfaction.
requirement.verification_executor: Quality with the owning implementation lane; mission assurance consumes resulting evidence only.

claim_conditions.state: Pinned input/predecessor, assigned task and phase, exact implementation, and declared starting state of the selected use sequence.
claim_conditions.causal_path: Authenticated ingress -> current admission -> exact bounded operation -> independently observed effect/result -> durable receipt -> permitted handoff; include negative cut points.
claim_conditions.authority: Host-authenticated principal and current grant/lease/policy for this exact operation; architecture change and final closeout stay human-bound.
claim_conditions.timing_freshness: Current policy/epoch at use; expiry exclusive; exact-candidate evidence; binding-specific evidence age and LOCAL-CTRL-1 or pinned model profile.
claim_conditions.invariant: Expiry is exclusive; full clock uncertainty interval must fit grant interval. Revoke and dispatch admission serialize within their authority domain. No admission after committed revoke; stale worker leases cannot commit. Unknown clock trust or rollback yields HOLD.
claim_conditions.impossible_if: Any observed effect or result contradicts the acceptance predicate; missing an indispensable causal edge makes the claimed explanation unproved.
claim_conditions.hold_if_missing: Any required witness, target/source pin, authoritative proof, resource profile, owner, or applicable assertion.

boundaries: unchanged and nextafter below expiry controls
equal and nextafter above expiry denials
all table logical state unchanged on denial and receipts immutable
traceability_addendum.relation: Add HMT-N07@1 alongside HMT-F02@1; no changed test/contract, and no supersession.
traceability_addendum.nonclaim: This does not qualify full uncertainty interval, unknown clock trust, or all revoke-race clauses of HMT-N07.

inspected: disposition contents and exact accepted head
personal_verification.scope: Existing accepted executable bytes; trace/docs only. Outside review consumed producer-run evidence, not independent execution.

next_bounded_task.scope: Reservation conflict lookup index; new/existing provisioning and preserved identity/cancellation semantics. No runtime integration.
